_readme_3: This file defines EVERY physical CMM machine and the folders it watches.
_readme_5: HOW TO ADD A NEW MACHINE:
_readme_6: 1. Copy one of the existing objects inside 'watch_directories'.
_readme_7: 2. Set 'machine_id' to a unique identifier for the new machine.
_readme_8: 3. Set 'source_path' to the root folder where CMM output files land.
_readme_10: 5. Adjust poll_interval_sec and max_workers based on the machine's output rate.
_readme_11: 6. Save and restart the service. No Python code changes needed.

conversion_watch.description: Folder watched for new conversion/mapping Excel sheets (3D HD Henkanhyou). When a new file lands here, the orchestrator imports it into pre_m_cmm BEFORE releasing the main pipeline queue.

destination_root.description: Root folder for the per-operation destination structure. The pipeline builds <destination_root>/<MC_NO>/<VEHICLE_MODEL>/<PARTS_CODE>/<OP_NO>/{_processing, _completed, _NG} automatically for every incoming file.

processing_folders.description: Legacy flat staging folders. Kept for backward compatibility but no longer used by the pipeline — the per-operation structure under 'destination_root' replaces them.
